user.title: New alarm system
user.description: Each alarm system is its own device with its own alarm entity. You choose the sensors afterwards in the options.

data_description.name: For example "House" or "Garage". The device and the alarm entity get this name.
data_description.night_enabled: Adds the mode "Night" with its own zone. Off by default.
data_description.code: 4 to 8 digits. Needed to disarm. Leave empty for no code.

error.invalid_code_format: The code must have 4 to 8 digits.

abort.already_configured: An alarm system with this name already exists.

init.title: Alarm system
init.description: Zones, delays and behaviour of this alarm system. The graphical setup in the side panel follows in a later version.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Sensors watched in each mode. A sensor can be in several zones.

data_description.zone_home: Watched when armed home, usually doors and windows.
data_description.zone_away: Watched when armed away, usually doors, windows and motion sensors.
data_description.zone_night: Watched when armed night. Only used when night mode is on.

data_description.exit_delay_home: Time to leave before the alarm system is armed. 0 arms at once.
data_description.exit_delay_away: Time to leave the house before the alarm system is armed.
data_description.exit_delay_night: Time before night mode is armed. 0 arms at once.
data_description.entry_delay: Time to disarm after an entry sensor opens.
data_description.entry_sensors: For example the front door. All other sensors trigger the alarm at once.
data_description.trigger_time: How long the alarm lasts before the alarm system returns to armed. 0 keeps the alarm until disarmed.

data_description.night_enabled: Adds the mode "Night" with its own zone. Off by default.
data_description.open_sensors: What happens if a sensor of the zone is open when arming.
data_description.code_arm_required: Arming also asks for the code. Only possible with a code.

code_section.name: Code
code_section.description: The code is stored only as a hash and never shown.

data_description.code: 4 to 8 digits. Leave empty to keep the current code.
data_description.remove_code: Disarming no longer needs a code.

error.entry_not_in_zone: Every sensor with entry delay must be in one of the active zones.
error.invalid_code_format: The code must have 4 to 8 digits.
error.code_and_remove: Enter a new code or remove the code, not both.
error.code_missing: "Code required to arm" needs a code.

code_locked.message: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

mode_not_enabled.message: The mode "{mode}" is not enabled for this alarm system.
